content:
sara_infra: Heads up — since ~09:10 UTC we're seeing spikes in NCCL allreduce latency on the p3-eu-azb pool. ~25% of multi-GPU jobs hit RDMA heartbeat timeouts and fall back to TCP, causing 3x latency. Anyone else seeing this?

miguel_runtime: Yep, got alerts and NCCL fallbacks. Logs show repeated rdma_cm disconnects and NET/IB timeouts. quick excerpt: `nccl: NET/IB timeout after 2000ms -> fallback`.

devon_sre: Which nodes specifically? I can pull mlx5 counters and ToR logs.

sara_infra: Affected nodes: p3-eu-azb-04..09. You can repro with our 4xV100 allreduce bench (nccl-bench). Iperf between GPUs looks fine (steady throughput) but we see tiny pps drops coinciding with the timeouts.

kira_net: That pattern smells like ToR egress policing/QoS dropping microbursts. If RDMA exchanges many small packets at once, a strict token-bucket can drop tails. Can you paste `dmesg`/mlx5 errors and `ethtool -S`?

allen_gpu: Dmesg from p3-eu-azb-05:```
[210123.456789] mlx5_core: QP 12345 state error: QP_TIMEOUT
[210123.456800] mlx5_core: CQ 6789 error 0x400000
[210123.456810] rdma: ib_unregister_mr: mr 0x7f8a... freed
```

miguel_runtime: NCCL logs show repeated `NET/IB` timeouts then TCP fallback. Batching shows lots of small control packets at iteration 0-10 — creates short microbursts.

devon_sre: Pulled ToR syslog for the AZB rack around 09:10:```
Mar 18 09:11:02 tor-azb kernel: policer: port 48 class 3 exceeded burst -> drop 42 packets
Mar 18 09:11:02 tor-azb kernel: qos: cls 3 token bucket exhausted
Mar 18 09:11:03 tor-azb kernel: policer: port 49 normal
```

kira_net: Yep — port48 saw policer hits ~every 10-15s for ~2min. That lines up with the allreduce starts. Two options: temporarily increase burst for RDMA-priority class or mark the RDMA VLAN as exempt. I can make a short patch. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sara_infra: Short-term bump sounds safe. Long-term we should tune the policer to allow short bursts that RDMA needs. Also add microburst test to our CI for GPU clusters.

ops-bot: Patch applied: ToR-azb-port48 increased burst to 200KB for QoS class 3 (rdma-priority) by kira_net at 09:42 UTC.

devon_sre: Post-patch: watched mlx5 counters on p3-eu-azb-05 for 10min — QP_TIMEOUT errors stopped. Ran 3x nccl-bench: p99 latency dropped from ~320ms -> ~78ms, mean from 110ms->32ms. Quick bench output:```
ALLREDUCE 4xV100 run1: p50 28ms p95 61ms p99 78ms
ALLREDUCE 4xV100 run2: p50 30ms p95 63ms p99 79ms
```

allen_gpu: No rdma heartbeat timeouts in the last 15m on affected nodes. I'll run an overnight 24h test and report.

sara_infra: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) kira to propose permanent QoS change and get infra approval; (2) infra to add microburst detection to nightly GPU health checks; (3) add a runbook entry about RDMA QoS sensitivity and how to triage `policer` hits. Keeping thread open til EOD. :memo:
